---
title: BANTER Model Predition Methods
---

## Methods

1.  Use the [BANTER_Predict](https://github.com/jlkeating/BANTER_Predict){target="_blank"} repository to package acoustic studies for the R package [BANTER](https://github.com/EricArcher/banter){target="_blank"} and conduct predictions using the PC vs OTHER model.
2.  Generate event summary plots of encounters predicted on.
3.  Evaluate using the following criteria each acoustic encounter scored above 50% for PC. (Note: to achieve a 90% or higher classification score of PC there needs to have been at least 10 acoustic signals within all the 8 possible detectors used in the model)
    -   \>10 signals with a detector
    -   Whistles contours are primarily between 4 & 9 kHz with 0.5 sec duration
    -   Echolocation signals are primarily between 12 & 22 kHz
